title: In a Mist and the words to its ending
summary: Eddie Miller told Hug Bix wrote words for the ending of In a Mist; Hug plays and reflects on it.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: Listening to classical music, then and now
